en: The Chapter on the Propped-Up Position 25.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were walking on their haunches in inhabited areas...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I will not walk on my haunches in an inhabited area.
One must not walk on one's haunches in an inhabited area.
Whoever, out of disrespect, walks on their heels in an inhabited area, commits an offense of wrong-doing (*dukkaṭa*).
There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first offender.
The fifth training rule is concluded.
